title: Wildfly: small WS-Policy document using repeated policy references can force Neethi to re-expand the… (CVE-2026-91865)
description: A vulnerability in Wildfly prior to version 42.0.0-r1 allows a denial of service via a crafted WS-Policy document. The issue arises when repeated policy references cause the Neethi engine to exponentially re-expand these references during normalization, leading to excessive CPU and memory consumption.
